description: Apply for the founding product reward with a product you published yourself: product_id, operator URL and the buyer use case (who buys it, the recurring task it solves and how they use the files). Confirm originality and the terms. Requires a bound receiving wallet, a price of at least 1 USDC, a README.md covering purpose, setup, usage, a worked example and limits, and at least one content file. A manual quality review precedes automatic payout; keep the reviewed version on sale until paid. Exact retries are safe.
